div.p: After he flew away from his home in Torrance, California, a grey parrot named Nigel was finally reunited with his owner Darren Chick four years later.

Nigel was found in a nearby village by Julissa Sperling, the owner of a dog-grooming business. The bird had been whistling and chattering outside her front door. She took him in as he matched a missing pet advertisement she’d seen a while ago. She explained he is the happiest bird she’s seen, singing and talking without control. Parrot Nigel was also barking along with the dogs.

Julissa was determined to reunite Nigel with his owner. Nigel had a microchip embedded in his leg, but it turned out that no one had registered the microchip. However, she managed to trace the sale of Nigel to an Animal Lovers pet store in Torrance. Luckily, the shop had kept its old sales records and had made a note of the band number that was originally on the bird’s leg so the owner could finally be tracked down. Darren Chick said that seeing his long-lost pet for the first time in four years brought a tear to his eye.

p.strong: Wat heeft Julissa Sperling gedaan om het baasje van papegaai Nigel te vinden?
